errors.what: gear3 (small green gear) is fixed on the same shaft as gear2 and must turn with it (clockwise, same angle as gear2). In the frames its reference marker rotates counter-clockwise, opposite to gear2's marker (for example at t=1.00 gear2's marker points down-right while gear3's points up-right; at t=2.00 gear2's points down while gear3's points up). So gear3 is spinning against gear2 instead of with it.
